Eli: Dad-joke contest: prompt the model to produce a pun about batch sizes. Winner gets a sticker. :trophy:
Harper: "Why did the batch cross the road? To reduce latency on the other side." :laughing:
Jo: Mine: "I told my model a joke about context windows. It said 'short, please' and closed the window." :window:
Akira: Okay but can we get serious for one second: what’s the model's favorite office snack? My vote: token chips (sea salt). :chip:
Eli: Poll: react with :one: token chips, :two: gradient granola, :three: quantized quinoa.
Harper: Also low-effort anthropomorphize: our 8-bit deploy hums lullabies to the KV cache at 3am. :zzz:
Jo: We should leave tiny name tags on the racks: "Meet Babbage: prefers structured prompts"
DevBot: NOTICE: please do not actually feed racks with snacks. Physical food near hardware is a security concern. :robot_face:
Akira: Noted, DevBot. Fine, virtual snacks only. Also I made a tiny comic where the model misunderstands "give me a raise" as "raise the learning rate". Tragic. :comic:
